aliases: Learn it / Practise it / Revise it
feature.summary: Study turns a chat into a tutoring session on one topic. The person picks a topic, a way (Learn it, Practise it, Revise it) and a level, optionally course material from a project and a starting study plan. The server then adds teaching instructions to every turn. Web and desktop (hosted) have a Study page; mobile has Study and learn, Cloud mode only.

purpose.what_it_does: Marks a conversation as a study session and injects a teaching instruction (one idea at a time, hints, worked examples, quizzes and flashcards as artifacts) into each model turn while the session is open (apps/web/features/study/server/study-session-store.ts:86-99, :114-141; apps/web/features/study/lib/study-session.ts:47-68).
purpose.why_it_exists: Brief S108.23 asks for an education workspace for teachers and learners (classes, assignments, guided study) and S108.24 for curriculum and lesson generation as structured output (doc: knowledge-base/data/area-briefs/108-specialist-workspaces.md). The migration says Study is a way of working through a subject, not a second kind of chat (apps/web/db/neon/0247_study_sessions.sql header).
purpose.who_uses_it: Learners; the shipped flow is learner-side. No teacher, class or assignment feature was found.
problems_solved: Chat answers dump a whole topic; Study makes the model teach one idea, check understanding, and wait (study-session.ts:22-26).

Practice without a quiz tool: quizzes and flashcards come out as artifacts the app renders (study-session.ts:47-56; apps/web/features/chat/components/artifacts/study/QuizView.tsx, FlashcardsView.tsx).
Finding a session again: sessions are listed and resumable (StudyPage.tsx:128-146).
use_cases: Learn eigenvalues from scratch with a worked example and a check question.
Practise German dative case with short exercises corrected one by one.
Revise a unit using attached course notes from a project and a personal study plan.

where_to_find_it: Web (and desktop via the hosted web app): left navigation item 'Study' to /chat/study (apps/web/shared/components/layout/app-nav-items.ts:144-150; hideable) and a 'Study' row in the composer plus-menu (ComposerPlusMenu.tsx:188, :873). Page heading 'Study'.

Mobile: composer add sheet row 'Study and learn', shown only in Cloud mode (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/AddToChatSheet.tsx:584-588, :1256-1261); screen titled 'Study and learn' (apps/mobile/src/features/study/StudyScreen.tsx:177, :207); route apps/mobile/app/(app)/study.tsx hidden from the drawer (_layout.tsx:105).
Chrome, CLI, VS Code: not available (brief; doc: docs/product/surface-feature-matrix.md:64, :289).
prerequisites: Signed in on web; on mobile the app must be in Cloud mode, else the screen says 'Study runs in AGI Cloud' with 'Switch to Cloud mode' (StudyScreen.tsx:177-197).
The conversation must be a live, non-temporary chat of the caller in the active workspace (study-session-store.ts:125-133).
screens_and_controls: Web Study page: 'What are you studying?' text box (max 200 characters), 'How' radio group with 'Learn it', 'Practise it', 'Revise it', 'Where you are with it' select with 'New to it', 'Some background', 'Know it well', 'Course material' select (only if projects exist), checkbox 'Start with a personal study plan', button 'Start studying', list 'Your sessions' with 'Leave study mode' and a resume control (StudyPage.tsx:103-146, :248, :285-289, :339-344; packages/contracts/types/src/study.ts:7, :19-35).

In a study chat: indicator 'Studying: <topic> · <mode>' and button 'Leave study mode' with note 'Turns off tutoring for this chat. The chat and its messages stay.' (StudyModeIndicator.tsx:8-9, :36-60).
Mobile: topic field (label 'What do you want to study?'), mode and level choices, 'Start studying', history with retry (StudyScreen.tsx:218, :239-269, :314-317).
journey: Type a topic, choose how and level, optionally pick course material and tick the study plan box.
Press Start studying; the app creates a conversation titled from topic and mode, then registers the study session on it (StudyPage.tsx:103-126).
If the plan box was ticked a plan request is placed in the chat draft (studyPlanRequest: order, time per part, checks, ask time per week) (study-session.ts:115-121).
Chat with the model; each turn carries the study instruction.
Quizzes and flashcards appear as artifact blocks the person can answer.
Press Leave study mode to end tutoring; the chat stays. Resume from 'Your sessions'.
feedback_and_outputs: Spinner 'Starting the study session' and error alerts such as 'The study session could not be started.' (StudyPage.tsx:121-124).
'Nothing yet. Subjects you study show up here.' for an empty history; 'Your study history could not be loaded.' on failure (StudyPage.tsx:93-99).
Quiz and flashcard artifacts; study set print helper (study-print.ts).
settings: Course material comes from the person's projects (StudyPage.tsx:248).
Account instruction and project instruction still apply: study instruction is a 'developer' layer ordered with project and personalized layers (request-processor.ts:2111-2125).

working: API: GET list or by conversationId, POST start (strict schema: conversationId uuid, topic 1-200 chars, mode, level), DELETE end (apps/web/app/api/study/sessions/route.ts:28-35, :50-114).
Store: start upserts on conversation_id and re-opens an ended session; ends set ended_at; list joins live conversations in the active workspace (study-session-store.ts:46-62, :114-158).
Server injects the instruction in the managed chat request and in the free-quota turn path (request-processor.ts:3820; apps/web/lib/server/free-quota-turn.ts:1074).
Web page and in-chat indicator (StudyPage.tsx; StudyModeIndicator.tsx).
Mobile screen with Cloud gating, history and retry (StudyScreen.tsx).
incomplete: Teacher, classes, assignments (part of S108.23) were searched in the study feature files and mobile screen and none were found; only learner flow exists.

Curriculum and lesson-plan output (S108.24) has no dedicated generator; it relies on the prompt text and plan request (study-session.ts:47-56, :115-121). Brief cites connector directory lines for it (vendor-directory.json:1028, :1728), not verified here.
disconnected_or_disabled: composeStudyPrompt, the function that ranks the study instruction against account instruction and current request, has no production caller; only its own test and the feature index use it (grep over apps and packages: apps/web/features/study/index.ts:16 and study-session.test.ts). The live path uses composeStudyInstruction placed in the 'developer' layer (request-processor.ts:2111-2122).
Migration 0247 header says 'NOT YET APPLIED : draft only'; applied state unknown.
not_available: Desktop-specific code: none; relies on hosted web (doc: AGENTS.md §5). The surface matrix lists desktop and mobile as absent (docs/product/surface-feature-matrix.md:64, :285-286); that conflicts with code for mobile (apps/mobile/src/features/study exists) and is a documentation error by AGENTS.md §2.

established.statement: S108.23 Should: an education workspace for teachers and learners (classes, assignments, guided study). Brief status: web done, desktop done, mobile missing, Chrome missing.
S108.24 Should: curricula and lesson plans (objectives, activities, materials) generated as structured output. Brief status as S108.23.
Starting a session needs a topic, mode and level validated by a strict schema.
One conversation holds one study session; a second start reopens it with the new topic.
Ending Study keeps the chat; nothing a user wrote is thrown away.
Precedence of instructions is decided by the shared resolver, not by Study.

acceptance_criteria: POST with a blank topic, an unknown mode or level, or extra fields is refused.
POST on a conversation the caller cannot see, a deleted one or a temporary one answers 404 'Conversation not found'.
DELETE with no running session answers 404 'No study session is running on that conversation.'
After start, the next chat turn in that conversation carries the study instruction; after Leave study mode it does not.
GET ?conversationId= returns the one session or an empty list; a non-uuid value is refused.
A mobile user in Local mode sees 'Study runs in AGI Cloud' and no start control.
A deleted chat's session disappears from 'Your sessions' and returns if the chat is restored (study-session-store.test.ts:60, :95).
inferred: The study instruction should apply the same way when a person brings their own key; where it is injected for non-managed routes is unknown [inferred].
Teacher and class features need new data (classes, assignments) [inferred from S108.23].
proposed: [proposed] Wire composeStudyPrompt into the live path or delete it.
[proposed] Add a lesson-plan and curriculum artifact type with fields for objectives, activities and materials.

steps.what_happens: Person fills the form and presses Start studying; the app creates a conversation through the chat conversations endpoint.
App posts the session; the server inserts or reopens one row per conversation after checking ownership, workspace, not deleted, not temporary.
App opens the chat; a ticked plan box leaves a plan request in the draft.
On each chat turn the server reads the open session and builds the study instruction into the system preamble.
The chosen model replies, writing quiz or flashcards blocks as artifacts.

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: The feature adds text to the system prompt; it works with whatever model the chat uses. Nothing model-specific was found in the feature files. Quiz and flashcard quality depends on the model following the artifact format.

missing_facts: The study instruction is read only when the request carries a conversation_id; with none, studyInstruction is null (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts:3987). POST and DELETE also require a CSRF token (apps/web/app/api/study/sessions/route.ts:76, :101), which section 7 omits.

The start flow is not atomic: the conversation is created first (StudyPage.tsx:107-110) and the session registered second (:111). A failure in the second step leaves an orphan non-study chat, and the page's edge-case table does not say so. Mobile does the same at StudyScreen.tsx:160-167.

DELETE (end session) scopes by user_id only, not by workspace (study-session-store.ts:152-158; route.ts:106), unlike GET and POST which also check organization. Section 7 describes rows as scoped by user and workspace for all methods.
